results.title: The Blessing
results.overview: Several people have barricaded themselves inside a bar. The music must never stop, otherwise something terrible could happen.

results.title: Found Alive
results.overview: Reeve LeClaire is still haunted by when she was held captive as a teenager by a sadistic man, but when her psychiatrist asks her to mentor a newly rescued survivor, she’s pulled into a chilling game of cat-and-mouse—one that threatens to drag her back into the nightmare she barely escaped.

results.title: Calamity Wayne
results.overview: In 1960s Belfast, timid ten-year-old Wayne hopes to impress his crush, Annette. Named after Western star John Wayne, he must summon his own courage when a bully challenges him to a showdown at the local cinema.

results.title: HER
results.overview: A two-faced woman who kills abusive men targets a rapist, but when she uncovers his secret, the hunter becomes the hunted. The film ultimately questions whether vigilante justice is born from cruelty or from a system that has failed its victims.

results.title: Yankıların İzinde
results.overview: Nevzat, the youngest son of a farming family, relapses into gambling one summer day while tending to the garden. His losses and debts grow, weakening his relationships with those around him. His mental breakdown also damages his family relationships. Hiding his situation, Nevzat becomes increasingly isolated and is forced to confront his addiction within his own inner world.

results.title: She Stole My Son's Heart
results.overview: After her last heart transplant fails, Maria is in desperate need of a new heart. Fearing it could give out at any moment, she turns down her boyfriend’s proposal and heads out for a walk — only to mysteriously disappear. As the search intensifies, homicide and missing persons detective Vicky and her rookie partner are assigned to the case. With Maria's time running out, it becomes a race to uncover the truth behind Maria's disappearance before her failing heart gives out.

results.title: Armani and the Birth of Italian Fashion
results.original_title: Armani and the Birth of Italian Fashion
results.overview: In his first—and final—on-screen interview, Giorgio Armani reflects on a life that reshaped global fashion. Armani and the Birth of Italian Fashion traces the rise of Italy’s style empires through the legendary families who defined an era, from Armani and Versace to Gucci, Valentino, Prada, and beyond. Set within Milan’s most exclusive fashion sanctuaries, the film explores creative rivalries, personal stories, and the enduring romance between Hollywood and Italian design. Featuring rare insights from fashion icons, actors, and cultural tastemakers, this star-studded documentary is an intimate portrait of ambition, elegance, and the making of modern luxury.

results.title: 100 Dates in Dallas
results.overview: A forty-something former actor navigates online dating in Dallas.

results.title: Frust
results.overview: A frustrated aspiring writer accidentally kills a drug dealer and becomes a reluctant dark hero, but as he spirals into more crimes, he must evade the police and question his own impact on society.

results.title: Stardom in Kobe 2026 Feb.
results.overview: Stardom in Kobe 2026 Feb. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on February 22, 2026 at Kobe Art Center in Kobe, Hyōgo, Japan.

results.title: Jie
results.overview: A young Chinese boy, Jie, navigates a new life in the U.S. while facing quiet family tensions and begins to grow through an unexpected friendship.

results.title: Karate Kiddo
results.overview: Twelve-year-old Sasha is forced to leave Moscow for Pyatigorsk to live with his aunt while his doctor parents are on assignment in Africa. Local children, school bullying, and conflict with the leader, Marat, become part of his new life. When his parents disappear during a flood, the boy faces utter despair. Seeking strength, he discovers a passion-karate, where his strict sensei, Dmitriy, and his daughter, Masha, help him overcome his fears, develop his character, and find inner strength.

results.title: Us, Maybe
results.overview: Rabin Angeles and Angela Muji bring the kilig and feels in this romantic episode about a cancelled influencer and the videographer who helps her heal away from the chaos. As Tala and Michael grow closer in the province, love blooms where they least expect it.

results.title: Stories That Made Us with George Stroumboulopoulos
results.original_title: Stories That Made Us with George Stroumboulopoulos
results.overview: George Stroumboulopoulos embarks on a cross-Canada road trip uncovering the films and TV shows that helped shape our national identity.

results.title: Suanggi: Ilmu Kutukan
results.overview: A debt-ridden, former vocalist relocates to his remote Papuan hometown under the pretense of visiting his terminally ill adoptive mother, masking a sinister plot to plunder her estate that inadvertently unleashes a lethal, ancient supernatural entity.

results.title: Original Wound
results.overview: After their mother’s death, a brother and sister remain in the house shaped by her control, negotiating conflicting memories of abuse and care. As ritual, body, and memory intertwine, their grief exposes a deeper entrapment, one that persists beyond her absence.
